# A test that sets the locale reads the program's own words and numbers in
# it, on every target, one instance down as well as at the top.
#
# Each target fell short a different way. Every target's i18n.numberFloat(x)
# left out the `style` it defaults, so the locale NoContext appends landed in
# its slot; the interpreter answered an entry point by its id, for env.Locale
# whatever t.setContext said, and translated against no manifest at all;
# android's test never ran MainActivity, which loads the manifest; and html
# translated a test's read of a `$"..."` for the browser's locale.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import i18n "sngl:i18n"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// A context a provider above the inner instance sets, which puts the instance
// under a provider as an app's pages are.
context #shelf("main")

component greeting ui.node {
    var count = 1

    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #hello(value=$"Hello")
        ui.text #size(value=i18n.numberFloat(0.5))
        ui.text #books(value=$"{count, plural, one{# book} other{# books}}")
        ui.button #more(text="more", @click { count += 1 })
    }
}

component inner ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #hello(value=$"Hello")
        ui.button #wave(text=$"Hello")
        ui.text #size(value=i18n.numberFloat(0.5))
    }
}

component outer ui.node {
    shelf("side") {
        inner #inner
    }
}

component plain ui.node {
    inner #inner
}

ui.window {
    greeting()
}

func testAWordInFrench(t test.Test, c greeting) {
    t.setContext(i18n.locale, "fr")
    t.assert(c.hello.value == "Bonjour")
    t.assert(c.size.value == "0,5")
    t.assert(c.books.value == "1 livre")
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.books.value == "2 livres")
}

func testAWordUnderAProviderInFrench(t test.Test, c outer) {
    t.setContext(i18n.locale, "fr")
    t.assert(c.inner.hello.value == "Bonjour")
    t.assert(c.inner.wave.text == "Bonjour")
    t.assert(c.inner.size.value == "0,5")
}

func testAWordOfAnInstanceInFrench(t test.Test, c plain) {
    t.setContext(i18n.locale, "fr")
    t.assert(c.inner.hello.value == "Bonjour")
    t.assert(c.inner.wave.text == "Bonjour")
    t.assert(c.inner.size.value == "0,5")
}
-- i18n.manifest.json --
{
  "Hello": {"translations": {"fr": "Bonjour"}},
  "{count, plural, one{# book} other{# books}}": {"translations": {"fr": "{count, plural, one{# livre} other{# livres}}"}}
}
